claim_ceiling: Structured public-reference ledger for benchmark design only. Government, operator and survey claims retain their original evidence class; they are not independently audited as-built data unless explicitly stated. Comparisons must preserve scope, meter boundary and date.

references.geography: European Marine Energy Centre, Scotland, UK
references.comparability_warning: Do not treat the five-year maintenance-free target as the completed operating duration. A two-year retrieved research trial is not a commercial lifecycle or cyber-resilience certification. Do not generalize non-matched server-failure cohorts.

references.project: Hainan underwater data centre and intelligent computing cluster
references.comparability_warning: Public reporting does not provide a fully matched, independently audited annual PUE, lifecycle cost, service-normalized energy, recovery RPO/RTO or physical/cyber threat benchmark.

references.status: first-phase demonstration in operation; larger project planned
references.comparability_warning: The 24 MW figure is the planned overall capacity; the first phase is 2.3 MW. Renewable share and PUE figures must retain their published project-claim/design-target status until independent interval meter data, system boundary and commissioning records are available.

references.project: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2026
references.comparability_warning: Survey statistics are not a controlled engineering trial. Equal-facility and capacity-weighted averages answer different questions. Do not compare site PUE without equivalent meter boundaries, mixed-use handling, annual period and climate.
Use the applicable 2026 text and measurement category. State mixed-use PUE variant and treatment of on-site generation/unaccounted energy.

references.project: Port of Ngqura breakwater wave-energy feasibility study
references.geography: Ngqura / Coega, Eastern Cape, South Africa
references.status: feasibility announcement; subject to development and permitting
references.comparability_warning: No hourly net output, capacity factor, storm availability, maintenance profile, firm capacity or grid connection is admitted. Do not translate installed MW directly into annual MWh or autonomy.

references.project: ENTSO-E — Data centres and the power system (April 2026)
references.geography: European power-system analysis; workload taxonomy is a reference, not a South African grid rule

metrics.value: AI/ML training and batch/data processing generally have higher time/geographic shift potential; inference medium/low; transactional real-time very low

references.comparability_warning: The flexible fraction depends on each workload, incentive and operator constraints. Do not infer that all compute is dispatchable or that a scheduler delivers fast grid response.

references.project: IEA 4E EDNA — Data Centres and Flexibility (July 2026)

metrics.value: market-serving, grid-serving and system-serving; workload, supporting infrastructure and additional flexibility assets

references.comparability_warning: Potential flexibility is not necessarily deployed flexibility; assess technical, economic and operational barriers locally.

references.project: ITU-T L.1312 (07/2026) — multi-dimensional environmental metrics and management for data centres

metrics.value: energy efficiency; resource efficiency; greenhouse-gas emission efficiency; environmental impact
The recommendation explicitly discusses aquatic-organism impacts from underwater data-centre construction, operation and maintenance and describes MSA relative to an undisturbed baseline.

references.comparability_warning: A composite multi-dimensional metric is supplementary. Report raw per-metric values and lifecycle stages. The project adds separate seawater intake/return and marine-effects accounting; do not infer these from freshwater WUE.

metrics.value: Publicly reported outages linked to fibre/connectivity issues are rising and more likely to cause extended disruptions.
External infrastructure failures are becoming more prominent in publicly reported outages.

references.comparability_warning: Reported incident trends do not provide a site-specific failure probability. They strengthen the case for externally verified fibre/utility common-cause analysis, but do not certify any recovery graph.

metrics.value: Grid capacity, congestion and connection queues are emerging as bottlenecks for supply, demand and storage.

references.comparability_warning: Global observations cannot be substituted for South African point-of-connection studies, utility letters or site-specific power-flow analysis.

references.project: UNESCO IOC / GOOS Essential Ocean Variables
references.status: current GOOS framework; specification sheets under revision

metrics.value: Subsurface temperature, subsurface salinity, subsurface currents, sea state, oxygen, nutrients, benthic invertebrate abundance/distribution (pilot), ocean sound

references.comparability_warning: GOOS says EOV specification sheets are under revision. Pin the specification version used in each observation campaign. Project-specific outfall, pollutant-flux and thermal-plume measures are not declared GOOS EOVs.

references.project: Ocean Biodiversity Information System — Manual v2.0 and Quality Control

metrics.value: Darwin Core; occurrence, event, extended measurement/fact and DNA-derived data profiles
Initial Darwin Core compliance; automated geolocation/date/depth/precision checks; manual node curation; taxonomic validation with WoRMS; geospatial enrichment; publication with flags

references.comparability_warning: Candidate Darwin Core terms are not a complete OBIS profile. Confirm current Manual/node requirements, taxonomy, data rights, attribution and sensitive-species location restrictions before publication.

references.project: ISO 5667-10:2026 — Water quality — Sampling — Part 10: Guidance on sampling of waste waters

metrics.value: Sampling guidance includes representative sampling of industrial and urban wastewater and cooling-water contexts.
Sampling programme design and representative sample collection are within the standard's scope.

references.comparability_warning: The synthetic flow-proportional-composite fixture is not an ISO-compliant sampling campaign. Actual sampling methods, preservation, analytes, location, timing, and laboratory QA/QC require a site-specific plan and qualified review.

references.project: JCGM 100:2008/Amd.1:2026 — Evaluation of measurement data: Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
references.status: 2026 amendment; published in JCGM guidance register

metrics.value: The amendment adds guidance addressing nonlinearity in measurement models.
JCGM 101 describes propagation of distributions using a Monte Carlo method.

references.comparability_warning: The project Monte Carlo fixture is an engineering cross-check with explicitly synthetic normal inputs and a common transport-lag variable. It is not a complete demonstration of GUM/JCGM conformity; real use requires justified input distributions, covariance, model adequacy and traceability.

metrics.value: 2.0 uses Thing, Location, Sensor, ObservedProperty, Datastream, Observation and Feature; Feature replaces FeatureOfInterest and supports proximate/ultimate feature links.
Datastream resultType and resultEncoding describe SWE-Common structures; units are represented in resultType rather than the removed v1.1 unitOfMeasurement field.
Observation and Datastream relationships include proximate/ultimate Feature links.

references.comparability_warning: The measurement bundle currently defines a normalized local mapping, not a SensorThings 2.0 API payload. Conformance requires schema validation and inspection of service $metadata; legacy v1.1 adapters must be explicitly versioned.

project_target_ladder.claim_ceiling: All are proposed objectives, not project results. Require matched workloads, identical service quality/deadlines, complete meter boundaries and independent evidence.
